title: Listening: Richard Ward on travelling well

sentences.en: Hello again.
sentences.zh: 大家好，又见面了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He’s visited more than a hundred countries.
sentences.zh: 他走访了 100 多个国家。

sentences.en: He’s taken thousands of photos and published them in travel magazines.
sentences.zh: 他拍了数千张照片，并把它们发表在旅游杂志上。

sentences.en: He’s got a very popular travel blog.
sentences.zh: 他有一个很受欢迎的旅行博客。

sentences.en: But he’s taken a break today to talk about how to travel well.
sentences.zh: 但今天他抽出时间，谈谈如何把旅行安排得更好。

sentences.en: Richard Ward, thank you for coming today.
sentences.zh: 理查德·沃德，谢谢你今天来到这里。

sentences.en: Thanks for inviting me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我。

sentences.en: So you’ve just completed your tenth year of travelling.
sentences.zh: 这么说，你刚刚完成了第十年的旅行。

sentences.en: That’s right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Ten years without spending more than a week back home.
sentences.zh: 十年里，每次回家都没超过一周。

sentences.en: Well, my parents’ home.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是我父母的家。

sentences.en: I’ve never had my own home.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有自己的家。

sentences.en: And to celebrate your ten years, you’ve made a list of top things to do when you travel.
sentences.zh: 为了庆祝这十年，你列出了一份旅行时最该做的事情清单。

sentences.en: That’s right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I’m hoping to publish them in a book later this year.
sentences.zh: 我希望今年晚些时候把它们出版成书。

sentences.en: Have you ever written a book before?
sentences.zh: 你以前写过书吗？

sentences.en: No, I haven’t.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: This will be my first.
sentences.zh: 这将是我的第一本书。

sentences.en: How exciting.
sentences.zh: 真令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Now, on your website, there are twenty tips for travelling.
sentences.zh: 现在，你的网站上有二十条旅行建议。

sentences.en: We can’t talk about all of them so can I ask you, what’s your number one tip?
sentences.zh: 我们没法全谈，所以我能问一下，你最重要的建议是什么？

sentences.en: Well, that’s difficult.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很难说。

sentences.en: My number one?
sentences.zh: 我最重要的建议？

sentences.en: Hmm.
OK.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: I’m going to say: ‘Get off the beaten track’.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是：“走别人少走的路”。

sentences.en: I mean, try and go to places that other people don’t go to.
sentences.zh: 我是说，试着去别人不去的地方。

sentences.en: Of course, it’s great to see all those famous places that everyone wants to see.
sentences.zh: 当然，去看看那些人人都想看的名胜很棒。

sentences.en: But if you explore a bit further, go to other places, you’ll discover much more interesting things, you know?
sentences.zh: 但如果你再多探索一点，去别的地方，你会发现更有趣的东西，你知道吗？

sentences.en: On my blog I talk about an important difference: the difference between travellers and tourists.
sentences.zh: 我在博客里谈到一个重要区别：旅行者和游客的区别。

sentences.en: A tourist always stays on the beaten track.
sentences.zh: 游客总是走常规路线。

sentences.en: A traveller likes to leave it.
sentences.zh: 旅行者则喜欢离开常规路线。

sentences.en: Of course, you might get lost …
sentences.zh: 当然，你可能会迷路……

sentences.en: And have you ever got lost?
sentences.zh: 那你迷过路吗？

sentences.en: Oh yes, hundreds of times.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然，有几百次。

sentences.en: In fact another of my tips is ‘try to get lost’!
sentences.zh: 事实上，我的另一条建议是“试着迷路”！

sentences.en: It’s part of the fun of travelling.
sentences.zh: 这是旅行的乐趣之一。

sentences.en: If you get lost sometimes, you can find amazing things, great people.
sentences.zh: 如果有时迷路，你可能会发现惊人的事物，遇到很棒的人。

sentences.en: OK, let’s talk about things to take with you.
sentences.zh: 好，我们谈谈要随身带的东西。

sentences.en: Another tip you have is: ‘always take a scarf’.
sentences.zh: 你的另一条建议是“总要带一条围巾”。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Well, a scarf is a really useful thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，围巾真的很有用。

sentences.en: You can wrap it around you to keep you warm or to keep the sun off.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它围在身上保暖，也可以遮阳。

sentences.en: You can carry things in it, too, or tie things together.
sentences.zh: 你还可以用它包东西，或者把东西系在一起。

sentences.en: Well, I want to talk some more, Richard.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我还想再聊一会儿，理查德。

sentences.en: But first it’s time for some music and …
sentences.zh: 但首先是音乐时间，而且……
